This endpoint will return:
1. A URL to redirect the end user to
2. Cookies will be set in the urlofprogram.com domain and the user will be redirected to a second URL
3. Cookies will be set in the crowdtwist.com domain and the user will be redirected to the final URL| | Method |POST| |Endpoint|https://[url_of_program]/http/v2/auth-sign-in?api_sig=[api signature]| |Content Type|application/x-www-form-urlencoded| #### Instructions For Use This call will add cookies to a browser that will log in an account to a CrowdTwist environment. Using a CrowdTwist test document that widgets set to the sign out state, invoking this API call will return a re-direct link in Response payload. Open this re-direct link the browser where the test document is open, and refresh the browser. The account will be logged into the CrowdTwist environment, and widgets will pull in relevant loyalty information.

## User Authentication Sign Out [UserAuthenticationSignOut.html](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/marketing/crowdtwist-develop/Developers/UserAuthenticationSignOut.html) | Item| Value| | ----------- | ----------- | | Description|In order to logout the user currently logged in to your loyalty program, the “auth-sign-out” endpoint can be used.
This endpoint will return:
1. A URL to redirect the end user to
Upon requesting this URL, cookies will be unset in the urlofprogram.com domain and the user will be redirected to a second URL
Upon requesting this second URL, cookies will be unset in the crowdtwist.com domain, and the user will be redirected to the final URL| | Method |GET| |Endpoint|https://[url_of_program]/http/v2/auth-sign-out?redirect=[redirect]&api_sig=[api_sig]| #### Instructions For Use You should extract the URL from the 'Location' response header, and deliver the end user to it. If using a test document, use the 'Location' link in the a logged browser then refresh the browser tab with logged in widgets. The user will proceed to have all of their CrowdTwist cookies expired, and they will be delivered to the “redirect” URL once the process is complete.

The Return API deducts points from the member’s account for the item(s) returned.| | Method |POST| |Endpoint|https://[environment]pos[client_id].crowdtwist.com/return| |HTTP Header|X-CT-Authorization = CTApiKey [API Key]

## Usable Coupons
[UsableCoupons.html](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/marketing/crowdtwist-develop/Developers/UsableCoupons.html)

| Item| Value|
| ----------- | ----------- |
| Description| This document describes the Usable Coupons endpoint in the REST v2 Users API. This endpoint returns a list of reward coupons which are available for use by a given program member. A coupon is considered usable if it has been assigned to the user through reward redemption, it has not yet itself been redeemed, and its expiration date (if it has one) has not yet passed. The correct operation of this endpoint depends on the client providing us with the information that a given coupon has been used. Currently this is only possible via the Commerce Purchase API. If we are not told that a coupon has been used, it will continue to show as usable even when it has already been used.|
| Method |GET|
|Endpoint|https://[environment]api[client_id].crowdtwist.com/v2/users/[userId]/usable_coupons?api_key=[api_key]&id_type=[id_type]|

#### Instructions For Use

No special instructions for use.
